_about: Grammar Lab's own grouping, written by hand (see scripts/grammar-lab-build.js). bands: in order, each with its units (pathways) in order. pathways: a unit's title, its parts (each an ordered list of topic ids, with an optional part title; a topic opens when the one before it in the unit is mastered) and optional marks ({ topic id: 'checkpoint' | 'review' }). topics: each topic once, by id, however many units use it: where its text is in source/course.md (the band section and the topic heading), an optional display title, its quiz format (tap, capfix, gaps, choice with choices.kind, passage, or fix with fix.kind; choices.cycle shows a choice as press-to-cycle; items for a 6-8 topic, whose lines each keep their own format, with read: check (the independent rule for its wrong options and pills), labels, chips (punctuation marks), fix (the fix kind), optional (commas taken with or without: intro, series), asIs (offer the right-as-it-is choice), cycle, answerHead and ruleWords), the line that asks the question, its levels (questions per level) and, for a topic with a Mistake Hunt room, the room's mistake kinds. scripts/grammar-lab-build.js reads this with source/course.md and writes topics.json.
